newsitem.title: UK: Pearson shares drop as Capel downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Pearson shares drop as Capel downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Pearson Plc dropped on Wednesday as analysts at HSBC James Capel cut the stock to "hold" from "buy" following its recent strong run, traders said.
The stock was off 8-1/2p at 716 by 1020 GMT, extending a decline since it reached a record high of 782p on October 30.
Analyst Jonathan Helliwell at Capel declined comment.

Pearson shares rose sharply towards the end of October, propelled by vague bid rumours. Carlton Communications Plc was seen as a possible predator though analysts remained sceptical that it would make an approach.

Pearson shares also received a boost last month, amid talk of disposals following the appointment of Marjorie Scardino as chief executive. Scardino, who has described the media group's profit performance as inadequate, takes over in January.
